dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region displays multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with irregular, scalloped outer perimeters. These features exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the dark primary coat to a high-intensity light-colored ring, surrounding a slightly lower-intensity internal core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is visible along the lateral margins. These clusters appear as discrete, asymmetrical speckles that lack an internal gradient and are interspersed between the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular quadrilateral. The three largest annuli in the anterior-dorsal cluster define a scalene triangle with its longest side approximately parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body.
